title: nf-core/pgdia pipeline parameters
description: A workflow to generate customized protein databases from RNA-Seq.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Create a design file with at least the `sample` column and either FASTQ columns (`fastq_1`, optional `fastq_2`) or BAM columns (`bam`, optional `bai`). Additional columns such as `strandedness` are supported. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/pgdia/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

save_merged_fastq.description: Publish FASTQs produced by concatenating multiple lanes.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

gtf.description: Path to gene annotation GTF used by StringTie / downstream steps.

protein_reference_db.description: Reference protein FASTA combined with cohort variant and novel-isoform proteins.

organism.description: Organism name for protein FASTA OS labels. Defaults to organism in the selected genome configuration; required for custom references without species metadata.

taxonomy_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ID for protein FASTA OX labels. Defaults to taxonomy_id in the selected genome configuration.

fasta_fai.description: FASTA index corresponding to the reference genome.

dict.description: Sequence dictionary corresponding to the reference genome.

gff.description: Optional GFF annotation used instead of GTF.

dbsnp.description: Known-sites VCF used by BQSR and variant calling.

dbsnp_tbi.description: Tabix index for the dbSNP/known-sites VCF.

known_indels.description: Optional known-indels VCF used by BQSR.

known_indels_tbi.description: Tabix index for the known-indels VCF.

save_reference.description: Publish generated reference files and indices.

igenomes_all_base.description: Base location for the custom GENCODE reference bundle.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

feature_type.description: GTF feature name used when generating the exon BED (e.g. exon, CDS, gene).

alignment_options.title: Alignment options
alignment_options.description: Options controlling RNA-seq read checks and STAR alignment.

read_length.description: Expected FASTQ read length. When omitted, it is detected from the first fastq_1 entry in the input samplesheet. When supplied, the pre-STAR check fails if it does not match that FASTQ.

read_length_check_reads.description: Number of records sampled from the first input FASTQ when detecting read length before STAR.

star_ignore_sjdbgtf.description: Do not add splice junctions from the GTF during STAR alignment.

star_max_memory_bamsort.description: STAR limitBAMsortRAM value; zero uses STAR's default.

seq_center.description: Sequencing center stored in BAM read groups.

seq_platform.description: Sequencing platform stored in BAM read groups.

bam_csi_index.description: Create CSI rather than BAI indices.

save_unaligned.description: Publish unaligned reads emitted by STAR.

save_align_intermeds.description: Publish intermediate aligned BAMs and indices.

remove_duplicates.description: Remove rather than only mark duplicate reads.

umitools_umi_separator.description: Separator placed before the extracted UMI in read names.

variant_database_options.title: Variant database options
variant_database_options.description: Options controlling cohort-level variant peptide database generation.

variant_peptide_require_pass.description: Use only variants whose VCF FILTER value is PASS when generating variant peptides.

variant_peptide_min_runs.description: Minimum number of RNA-seq runs supporting a variant peptide sequence.

cohort_db_id.description: Identifier used for the cohort-level variant peptide database.

cohort_expected_runs.description: Exact number of unique run-level variant FASTAs required before cohort database generation.

variant_calling_annotation_options.title: Variant calling and annotation options
variant_calling_annotation_options.description: Options controlling RNA-aware variant calling, filtering and annotation.

tools.description: Variant annotation tool or tool combination.

skip_intervallisttools.description: Do not scatter the interval list.

skip_variantfiltration.description: Skip hard filtering of called variants.

skip_exon_bed_check.description: Skip filtering exon intervals against reference contigs.

gatk_interval_scatter_count.description: Number of GATK interval shards per RNA-seq run.

generate_gvcf.description: Generate GVCF rather than per-run VCF output.

build_snpeff_refseq_cache.description: Build a local snpEff database from the selected FASTA and GTF.

download_cache.description: Download annotation caches rather than using configured resources.

snpeff_genome_name.description: Display name used when building a local snpEff database.

vep_include_fasta.description: Provide the genome FASTA to VEP.

vep_dbnsfp.description: Enable or configure the VEP dbNSFP plugin.

vep_loftee.description: Enable or configure the VEP LoFTEE plugin.

vep_spliceai.description: Enable or configure the VEP SpliceAI plugin.

vep_spliceregion.description: Enable or configure the VEP SpliceRegion plugin.

dbnsfp_tbi.description: Index for the dbNSFP data file.

spliceai_snv_tbi.description: Index for the SpliceAI SNV resource.

spliceai_indel_tbi.description: Index for the SpliceAI indel resource.

outdir_cache.description: Output directory for downloaded annotation caches.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory available to the pipeline.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs available to the pipeline.

max_time.description: Maximum process wall time available to the pipeline.

show_hidden.description: Show hidden parameters in help output.

showHidden.description: Compatibility alias for showing hidden parameters.
